propositions: Container drain timeout (45s) is shorter than review timeout (1200s), causing in-flight reviews to be interrupted and fail-closed with -1 vote, blocking the backfill reconciler's recovery mechanism.

Git fetch timeouts (300s) and other retryable errors (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) are currently voted as fail-closed -1, making changes invisible to the reconciler's backfill re-drive.
Increase DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1200 and compose stop_grace_period to 1320s to allow in-flight reviews to complete before container shutdown.

Implement vote-less deferral for retryable gap reasons (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) with bounded escalation: after RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3), cast fail-closed -1 and emit VOTER_ERROR.
Record retry attempts in a new review_attempts table (keyed by change_id and revision) with reset semantics (DELETE row) to enable shared retry budget with manual re-trigger mechanism.
Terminal outcomes (indeterminate, finding, merge-coverage-gap-decision) continue to cast fail-closed -1; only retryable conditions defer vote-less to remain eligible for reconciler backfill.
